headline: Ride with me
intro: Riding together is the best way to meet me, see how I coach and get faster. Here's where you'll find me most weeks. Everyone who can hold a wheel is welcome.
image_alt: A group of cyclists riding together on an open road

weekly.name: Hill Climbers ride
weekly.text: A social, hilly morning ride with the Hill Climbers community.

weekly.name: Breakfast Club ride
weekly.text: Weekend group ride with a coffee stop.

photo_alt: Mark Duroy in a red Velo-Savvy jersey riding behind a group on a curving road
photo_text: I'm usually somewhere in the group in Velo-Savvy kit. Come and say hello: I'm always happy to talk training, pacing or anything else on the road.
strava_text: Join the Velo-Savvy Strava club to see ride details, routes and last-minute changes.
